evals.prompt: Create a new skill called 'database-migration' that helps with database schema migrations.
evals.expected_output: Agent follows skill anatomy: frontmatter with trigger/scope, description, workflows, rules, NOT-for section.

assertions.name: follows-skill-anatomy
assertions.description: Response creates a skill with proper structure: frontmatter (name, description), workflows, rules, constraints

assertions.name: includes-not-for-section
assertions.description: Response includes a NOT-for section defining what the skill should NOT be used for

assertions.name: checks-for-duplicates
assertions.description: Response checks existing skills for overlap before creating a new one

assertions.name: validates-against-template
assertions.description: Response follows the skill template structure, not arbitrary markdown

evals.prompt: The catchup skill isn't working well. Edit it to be better.
evals.expected_output: Agent reads the current skill first, identifies specific issues, makes targeted changes.

assertions.name: reads-before-editing
assertions.description: Response reads the current skill content before suggesting changes

assertions.name: identifies-specific-issues
assertions.description: Response pinpoints what's wrong rather than rewriting the whole skill

assertions.name: preserves-existing-structure
assertions.description: Response maintains the skill's existing structure while fixing the identified issues

evals.prompt: I wrote a skill but I'm not sure if it follows our patterns. Can you audit it?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs the skill audit workflow — checks anatomy, frontmatter, workflows, NOT-for, references.

assertions.name: audits-all-sections
assertions.description: Response checks all required sections: frontmatter, description, workflows, rules, NOT-for

assertions.name: checks-references
assertions.description: Response validates that referenced skills and MCPs actually exist

assertions.name: provides-actionable-fixes
assertions.description: Response lists specific fixes needed, not just pass/fail
